snippet.title: NAMMO -  Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: NAMMO is a soulslike boss rush game that, according to developer Guild Studio, is "set during Korea’s Silla Dynasty, which spanned from 57 BC to AD 935 (nearly a millennium). It combines a dark fantasy world with a Soulslike boss-rush experience." Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863810/NAMMO/
